name: million-dollar-app
description: E-commerce application with Docker and Jenkins automation for the system architecture final project

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix services/auth-service && npm install --prefix services/catalog-service && npm install --prefix services/order-service && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: cross-env DB_HOST=127.0.0.1 concurrently -k -n auth,catalog,orders,frontend "node services/auth-service/server.js" "node services/catalog-service/server.js" "node services/order-service/server.js" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: node -e "console.error('No root test suite is configured; run the documented service and Docker integration checks.'); process.exit(1)"
